title: Array data not reactive when mutating it and not using it in template or computed

labels.name: has workaround
labels.description: A workaround has been found to avoid the problem

labels.name: :hammer: p3-minor-bug
labels.description: Priority 3: this fixes a bug, but is an edge case that only affects very specific usage.

body:
### Version
3.0.0

### Reproduction link
[SCF Playground](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)

### Steps to reproduce
Set an array as data, do not use/display it in template, push some data into it, the array is not updated.

### What is expected?
The array should be updated when pushing elements into it.

### What is actually happening?
The array is not updated, except if it is displayed or used in the template

---
If you uncomment the <!--span>{{checkboxes}}</span--> part in the template on the SFC playground, the array will be updated as intended.

I wanted to check/uncheck checkboxes using a method instead of the checkboxes itself, and the checkboxes would not check/uncheck when calling the method.
